note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: The Q2 10-Q says that if the refinancing plans are not completed before the end of fiscal 2026, the $201M of debt reclassifies to a current liability. findings.finding: Two fast-casual peers that reported after Sweetgreen's 2026-08-06 guide cut say the food-safety demand hit faded within Q3. Chipotle's Q3 10-Q (filed 2026-10-28): headwinds began in July, worsened for several weeks, and comps were back to pre-headwind levels by end of August. CAVA's Q3 release (2026-11-04): cyclospora cut Q3 SRS by only ~150bp, Q3 SRS was +3.1%, and FY SRS was RAISED to 6.0-7.0% from 4.5-6.5%. Sweetgreen's own FY SSS guide of -8% to -7% was cut from -4% to -2% on an 'uncertain' recovery, and management put the July hit at ~600bp, so a category recovery by Sept/Oct supports a held-to-raised SSS guide on Thursday.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide cut on the outbreak (2026-08-06) drew -8.0%. Q1 2026, where management cited April improving to ~-8%, drew +1.9%. 5 of 7 prior prints fell, and SG has not been paid much for good sales news.

findings.finding: The FY26 SSS guide of -8% to -7% is soft arithmetic against the compares. H1 SSS was -12.8% and -6.2%, so the guide implies an H2 average of about -4.5% to -6.5%, against prior-year compares of -9.5% (Q3'25) and -11.5% (Q4'25). The pre-outbreak guide (-4% to -2%) implied H2 around +3.5%. If the company-quantified ~600bp July drag faded by September, as peers report, then Q3 near -7% and Q4 near -4% land at the guide midpoint, and a flat-to-positive Q4 puts the top end or a raise in play.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance is what SG trades on: -8.0% on the 2026-08-06 cut, -9.6% on 2026-02-26 and -23.1% on 2025-08-07, both of which carried guide reductions.
